summary: Attendance/classes app: users add students to classes (7/8/9). Reported bug that previously added students have disappeared; user requested a fix build. Also requested ability to download monthly attendance data.
known_issues: Bug: Students previously added to classes (7/8/9) are now missing/disappeared from the app/screens.

existing_features.title: Update the add-student flow so that student IDs are generated in a globally unique way (not based on the count within the currently selected class/section).

Add a safe recovery/diagnostic path in the UI for when the current class/section shows no students, helping confirm whether data exists in the backend (e.g., by optionally loading a count of all students) and showing a clear English error/state message when unauthorized or when data is genuinely empty.

new_feature_requests.summary: Allow downloading monthly attendance data (export report in PDF/Excel/CSV with month selection)
Prevent students from disappearing when users add students in multiple classes/sections by eliminating ID collisions in the backend storage keying strategy.
Persist student records (and any required ID counters/indexes) across canister upgrades so previously added students do not disappear after a redeploy/upgrade.

projectName: Fix missing students across classes (ID collisions + persistence across upgrades)
